description:
Job Profile- PeopleSoft Developer/Programmer (People Tools 8.X Specialist)
 Duration-24 Months
 Location- Albany, NY
 

 Candidates should have at least 84 months experience following should apply-
 1. Programming experience developing with PeopleTools on the NYS Department of Civil Service NYBEAS (New York Benefits Eligibility and Accounting System) application. (Creation of ‘run control’ panels or pages, PS/Query development, Crystal Reports development and SQR development will NOT be considered qualifying PeopleTools developing experience.)
 2. Programming experience developing with PeopleTools at release levels 8.X or higher in PeopleSoft Accounts Receivable or General Ledger modules.
 3. Experience using SQL against an Oracle relational database to support PeopleSoft related tasks working in a UNIX environment
 



 If you are interested in finding out more about opportunities near you, if you are in need of a staffing firm such as ours, or if you just have a question regarding your resume and career path, please email me at ryan askitc.com
